description.translate: Bring sixteen warped planks for the sleeping wing and supply shelter. We need a roof that belongs to the people beneath it, not another office that demands a report. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

That will keep the stores dry. We helped his expeditions with supplies, shelter and escorts. The Ranker promised to help this refuge recover. He kept pursuing the next creature's power while we waited for the help he owed us. Your repairs are the part of that promise we can finally see.
